div.div:
EventService
[Component: @Service · @Transactional]
create() · update() · findById()
search() · cancel() · postpone()
Event lifecycle with status transitions:
DRAFT → PUBLISHED → POSTPONED / CANCELLED / COMPLETED
Validates venue, creates TicketTypes,
paginated search: city, artist, venueId, date.

div.div:
VenueService
[Component: @Service · @Transactional]
create() · findById()
findByCity() · findAll()
Hierarchical venue creation:
Venue → Sections → Seats (cascade persist).
Assigned-seating and general-admission.
Seat maps only for assigned-seating.

div.div:
Event Status State Machine
[Business Rule: validateStatusTransition()]
DRAFT → PUBLISHED, CANCELLED
PUBLISHED → POSTPONED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED
POSTPONED → PUBLISHED, CANCELLED
CANCELLED → (terminal)
COMPLETED → (terminal)
Invalid transitions → BusinessRuleException
